pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Space Station.

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: With the current setting, phase one blocks the arrow and mob_projectile damage types. Parries, arm blocks, teleportation and specific animations provide other rejection conditions. A phase transition can reduce damage rather than cancel it. Change your rhythm: wait out the block and strike in a short sequence.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. Start combat from the boss encounter menu. In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Portal Shard. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
